name: app-twelve-glass-metric-tiles-over-blurred-smartwatch-photo
title: Grid of frosted glass metric tiles with serif numerals over a blurred wrist-watch photo
whatItIs: A blurred photo of a wrist with a smartwatch on a blue background overlaid with twelve frosted rounded tiles (HDL-C, ApoB, RHR, HRV, LDL-C, Weight, VO2 Max, Waist:Height, Resting HR, Zone 2, Body Fat), each with a pill label, a serif numeral, a unit and a green or red status word.
whatItMeans: Calm and personal; glass tiles turn lab data into a friendly constellation.
techniques: Scatter glass tiles at varied sizes over a photo.
Colour status words green or red.
Label with a small grey pill.

vocabulary.definition: A frosted rounded tile with a metric.
A green or red word saying in range or high.
A small capsule naming a metric.
